# iosxe_voice_class_dpg (Resource)

This resource can manage the Voice Class DPG configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_voice_class_dpg" "example" {
  tag      = 200
  shutdown = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class dialpeer group tag
  - Range: `1`-`10000`

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `dial_peers` (Attributes List) Add a dialpeer to the group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dial_peers))
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Put dial-peer group to inactive state

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--dial_peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dial_peers`

Required:

- `dial_peer_id` (String) Voice dial-peer tag

Optional:

- `preference` (Number) Preference order of this dialpeer in a group
  - Range: `0`-`10`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_voice_class_dpg.example "<tag>"
```
